notes.title: Launch of Operation Armstrong 🚀
notes.notes:
After 2.5 years in development we're happy to announce Operation Armstrong is now available for purchase!
Gather your friends and get ready for an intense co-op experience!

notes.title: Albejorn Stream
notes.notes:
Albejorn has a history with the game- having smashed all of the scores set in PAX 2020. Now we'll see if she can do it again!

Audience participation is encouraged here and will be managed via her discord channel:
https://discord.gg/2qzkC3W

notes.title: Dev Stream 3.0
notes.notes:
The Devs, Jay and Halen, will be playing their game and answering community questions.
Though honestly: we just want to use this opportunity to beat all the demo players scores since we've noticed our names have been slipping down the leaderboards...
In any case- it'll be fun!

notes.title: Jan 2021: Beta come check out Operation Armstrong!
notes.notes:
Hello hello,

We are finally getting our act together on this whole Beta thing so if you're interested in playing the game to give us some much appreciated feedback (Or you just want to quietly lurk on our discord server while maintaning an excuse to play the game for free before it comes out (Which I totally understand)) then keep reading!

Start date will be sometime in Jan, end date will be sometime later (A bit before official release a few months afterwards). Access will be free but will only last for the duration of the Beta. The exact distribution method is also TBC. For now though, we're using our discord server as the central location for Beta information, management and feedback so if you're interested in participating, check that out at: 
https://discord.gg/cRZwp4SYJR

We're really excited for you guys to try out some of our latest features and keen to finally get the game we've worked so hard on into your hands!

Cheers,
Jay and Halen

notes.title: Test Stream
notes.notes: Due to technical difficulties we're just testing to make sure the stream is working okay, Apologies for any inconvenience.

notes.title: Dev Livestream the II
notes.notes: In this session we'll playthrough some levels and will run through some tips and tricks on how to build engaging levels for Operation Armstrong. We will then be playing levels submitted by the community.

notes.title: Sneak Preview Demo
notes.notes:
Play as the VR Operative stuck deep behind enemy lines trying to remain undetected as they move through the deadly lunar fortress.
The Operative won't last long without help. Players outside the VR must be the voice in the earpiece and help guide them through the fortress. They must also use their phones to hack into the security systems if there is to be any chance of success.

notes.title: Q&A session with Fullbeans Studio (Discord - link in description)
notes.notes:
Fullbeans Studio is a new Melbourne studio formed by a pair of programmers who wanted to chase their dreams of becoming game developers. Now, a year and a half into the roller-coaster that is games development, come and ask them anything about their upcoming game Operation Armstrong, how they have found games development or any other curiosities on your mind.

The AMA discord https://discord.gg/BcTjkp
